description: This file defines a test runner class for Orleans transaction fault tests using xUnit. It extends a base test runner and provides specific test methods decorated with data-driven test attributes for various transaction scenarios.

classes.name: GrainFaultTransactionTestRunnerxUnit
classes.description: A specialized test runner class for Orleans transaction fault tests using xUnit, inheriting from GrainFaultTransactionTestRunner.
